messages:
evan: onboarding sampleapp failing in json-mode: js validator errors when tool returns top-level array.
maya: paste small repro?
evan: tool returns `[ {"item":"x", "count":1 } ]` and sample schema expects an object.
rolf: i think python helper silently unpacked single-element arrays; js is strict. also found retry path that JSON.stringify()s results on 5xx recovery, making it a string.
maya: options: (1) weaken schema, (2) fix retry stringify, (3) add normalize helper in JS to parse strings and unpack single-item arrays.
rolf: prefer 2+3. i'll add a tiny util `normalizeFnResult(raw, schema)` that: if typeof raw === 'string' try JSON.parse; if Array.isArray(v) && schema.type==='object' && v.length===1 then v = v[0]; return v. add telemetry when coercion happens.
ci-bot: opened issue #3612: "devex: js sdk normalize fncall outputs; remove stringify-on-retry" by rolf
evan: i'll patch sampleapp locally to accept array until helper lands; maya pls add unit tests for stringified-array + array cases.
maya: will add tests in samplekit/tests and run e2e with --json-mode.
rolf: i'll keep change behind feature flag `helpers.normalizeFncall` and include migration notes.
evans: thanks, keeping thread open until PR merges and tests pass.
